name: Null-Scattering Extension
definition: A generalization of the equation of transfer using null scattering to allow sampling from a modified transmittance equation. It homogenizes the medium's density to a fixed majorant $\sigma_{maj}$ to enable unbiased estimates using algorithms like delta tracking.
summary: Null-Scattering Extension homogenizes heterogeneous media density to a constant majorant, enabling unbiased sampling with algorithms like delta tracking.
